item.title: Tellus Magnetic — raw airborne flight-line data source files
item.subtitle: Geology and Geophysics / GSNI, Tellus, BGS
item.description: Raw magnetometer readings along each Tellus survey flight line — the original point measurements that the gridded "Tellus Magnetic" products on this site are derived from. Typically ~250 m line spacing with samples every ~7 m. Useful only if you want to re-grid with custom parameters or interrogate noise; for a map-style view use the gridded TMI / RTP / RTP-Tilt cards in this category.
